name: WNBA_R3A3_REMAINING_SIGNAL_FAMILY_CUSTODY_CONTRACT_V1

source_custody.required_asset_rule: Exact pinned release asset id, byte size and SHA-256 must reproduce before any source classification may pass.

historical_candidate_semantics: offensive eFG%, 3PAr and FTr from prior finalized games
defensive allowed eFG%, 3PAr and FTr from the paired opponent row of prior finalized games
offensive rebounding versus opponent defensive-rebounding interaction from prior finalized games
L5 and L10 prior-game scoring margin
L5 and L10 prior-game estimated possession efficiency
opponent-quality adjustment only after its exact formula is separately frozen before outcome evaluation
meeting count strictly before target date
win share strictly before target date
average margin strictly before target date
H2H_PREFIX.two_season_window_rule: target season plus immediately preceding season only
H2H_PREFIX.known_boundary: Full two-season support for a 2020 target requires a separately pinned 2019 source; this contract does not silently impute that missing previous-season history.

FATIGUE_TRAVEL_V2.actual_trip_sequence_requirement: Historical venue coordinates and venue identity for every prior stop must be separately certified before actual trip-distance or timezone sequence may enter R3.

AVAILABILITY_STAR_POWER.current_backend_source: Live ESPN injury page scraper with daysOut evaluated against current time.

required_audit_evidence: All 2020-2025 pinned team-box assets reproduce exact custody.
Required schema columns for each reconstructible family are present in every audited season.
Every accepted regular-season game has exactly two coherent opponent rows, one HOME and one AWAY.
All score/possession component values needed for quality-form and H2H reconstruction are finite where required.
Shot-profile offensive and opponent-allowed components are pair-reconstructible without external current snapshots.
Date-based fatigue features are reconstructible strictly from prior official dates.
No claim of actual historical travel sequence is made unless venue-coordinate custody passes separately.
Availability remains blocked historically unless an independently timestamped archive is certified.
